items.title: Ueno: ahorristas con hasta G. 5 mil millones recuperarán sus depósitos
items.summary: Se prevé que con la venta de activos sanos del fallido banco se cubra el 99,9 % de los depósitos; el centenar de grandes depositantes que reste irán por una liquidación extrajudicial.
items.titleEn: Ueno: savers with up to G. 5 billion will recover their deposits
items.summaryEn: The sale of the bankrupt bank's sound assets is expected to cover 99.9% of the deposits; the remaining 100 large depositors will go through an out-of-court settlement.

items.title: Milei da un espaldarazo político a Alliana con visita a Asunción
items.summary: El presidente de la República Argentina, Javier Milei, concretó ayer su visita oficial al Paraguay para reunirse en el Palacio de Gobierno con su par paraguayo, Pedro Alliana.
items.titleEn: Milei gives political back to Alliana with visit to Asunción
items.summaryEn: The President of the Argentine Republic, Javier Milei, made his official visit to Paraguay yesterday to meet in the Government Palace with his paraguayan, Pedro Alliana.

items.title: Hubo alta demanda en consultas oftalmológicas gratuitas en ANR

items.titleEn: There was a high demand for free eye consultations in ANR
items.summaryEn: The following week, the free eye consultation service will be held on Tuesday and Thursday at the Board of Governors.
